tools.name: invert_pdf_base64
tools.description: Invert colors of a base64-encoded PDF (up to 2 MB) directly into a downloadable dark-mode PDF. For larger files or photo-preserving conversion (keeping photos in original colors), use https://pdfdark.org/invert-pdf-colors.

tools.name: get_dark_mode_presets
tools.description: List all PDF Dark theme presets (Midnight, Sepia, Solarized, OLED, Pure Invert) with RGB swatches and image handling modes.

tools.name: recommend_pdf_settings
tools.description: Recommend the optimal PDF Dark tool page, theme preset, and image-handling mode based on document type and reading device.

tools.name: get_tool_url
tools.description: Get the direct zero-upload browser tool URL on pdfdark.org for a specific PDF task and language.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_tool_url · Private data: invert_pdf_base64, recommend_pdf_settings · Public sink: get_tool_url.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_tool_url · Private data: invert_pdf_base64, recommend_pdf_settings · Public sink: get_tool_url

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
